scope: Local fixes only. No publishing, backend writes or changes to approved five ml masters.

changes: Translucent polymer pump housing with source-photo cylindrical cartridge and tapered lower connection.
Longer, legible spring and internal stem; slim centered tube.
Same mechanism at each size for black and white.
smallSprayers.correctionToInitialDiagnosis: The old spring object was present and render-enabled. Its appearance was poorly legible with the earlier housing, material and composition; it was not absent from the native scene.
smallSprayers.inferred: Mechanism dimensions are guided by original exact-SKU photos, not manufacturer measurements. New mechanism appearance awaits user review.

notes: Tube diameter and concealed neck geometry are modeling assumptions, not supplier measurements.
Mechanism v2 uses the current 1.6 mm base: actual tip clearance is 1.9 mm. The housing and spring follow the exact-SKU source photo visually.

Mechanism v2 corrects the translucent pump housing, taper and visible spring against source photos. Bottle geometry is unchanged. Tube component IDs retain their associated head finish; image, position, opacity and animation data match.
Both sizes use a modeled 1.1 mm tube and 1.9 mm tip-to-floor gap, not independently measured supplier specifications.
Mechanism v2 metadata uses the current profile-v4 floor of 1.6 mm.
The 3.3 ml name retains legacy 3ml SKU identifiers.
Both sizes remain product-page only. Production is unchanged.

changes: 24 local Elegant 60 ml reducer SKU kits now include seated and full plug render layers from the existing 18-415 reducer model.
Cap off leaves the insert seated; cap on reseats the cap; exploded lifts the full plug and cap.
Fitment tile shows one reducer; callout correctly describes press-fit seating.
Kits without a reducer insert retain assembled-only presentation rather than offering a fake cap-off.
reducer.inferred: 1.6 mm reducer orifice inherited from existing traced model, not manufacturer measured.
